title: Levi Strauss & Co. migration case study (lab 2) quiz

questions.stem: What motivated Levi Strauss & Co. to migrate to the cloud?
questions.zhStem: 是什么促使 Levi Strauss & Co. 迁移到云？
options: Rules that required each country to keep its own ERP
A direct-to-consumer shift, costly datacenters, and technical debt
A plan to keep its processes exactly as they were
A failed datacenter that had to be replaced in a week
questions.explain: The shift to direct-to-consumer, costly datacenters, and technical debt motivated the move, because the new model needs speed and unified data that nine ERP systems and owned datacenters could not give.
questions.zhExplain: 推动迁移的是转向直接面向消费者、数据中心成本高昂和技术债务，因为新模式需要速度和统一数据，而九个 ERP 系统和自有数据中心无法提供。

questions.stem: What additional questions would you ask to better understand the company's existing infrastructure, applications, data, security, and business requirements?
questions.zhStem: 你还会提出哪些问题，以更好地了解该公司现有的基础设施、应用、数据、安全和业务需求？
options: Which new features should developers add once everything runs on Azure?
What will the right-sized Azure bill be one year after cutover?
Which Azure VM size should every server use after migration?
Which applications depend on each other and must move in the same wave?
questions.explain: Ask which applications depend on each other, because dependent applications must move in the same wave or they break during migration.
questions.zhExplain: 应询问哪些应用相互依赖，因为相互依赖的应用必须在同一批次迁移，否则迁移期间会出现故障。

questions.stem: Who are the main migration stakeholders? What are their roles and responsibilities in a RACI matrix?
questions.zhStem: 主要的迁移利益相关者有哪些？他们在 RACI 矩阵中的角色和职责是什么？
options: Only the IT team, and every member is A for every activity
Only Microsoft, which is both R and A for all the work
Sponsor, IT, security, business, and Microsoft, with one A per activity
Business leaders only, and R and A always go to the same person
questions.explain: The stakeholders run from the executive sponsor to Microsoft, with one Accountable owner per activity, because RACI needs a single owner while the people doing the work are Responsible.
questions.zhExplain: 利益相关者从执行发起人到 Microsoft，每项活动只有一个 Accountable 负责人，因为 RACI 需要唯一的负责人，而实际做事的人是 Responsible。

questions.stem: Nine regional ERP systems must become one set of standard processes and unified data. Which approach fits?
questions.zhStem: 九个区域 ERP 系统需要统一为一套标准流程和统一数据，哪种方式合适？
options: Rehost each ERP system as-is onto Azure virtual machines
Retire all nine ERP systems without any replacement
Replace them with one global ERP platform
Refactor each ERP system onto Azure Kubernetes Service
questions.explain: Replace the nine systems with one global ERP platform, because rehosting or refactoring each one would keep nine different processes and data models.
questions.zhExplain: 应用一个全球 ERP 平台替换这九个系统，因为对每个系统做重新托管或重构仍会保留九套不同的流程和数据模型。

questions.stem: Which cloud migration approach is most appropriate for Levi Strauss & Co.? Why?
questions.zhStem: 哪种云迁移方式最适合 Levi Strauss & Co.？为什么？
options: Refactor every application first, so nothing needs changing after the move
Replace every application with SaaS, so no servers need migrating at all
Retire the datacenters first, then decide what to do with the applications
Rehost first, to exit the costly datacenters fastest and improve workloads later
questions.explain: Rehost first and refactor selectively, because lift and shift exits the costly datacenters fastest, while rearchitecting 160 applications beforehand would delay both the exit and the savings.
questions.zhExplain: 应先重新托管、再有选择地重构，因为直接迁移能最快退出昂贵的数据中心，而先重构 160 个应用会推迟退出和节省成本的时间。

questions.stem: What would a high-level schedule for the migration process look like?
questions.zhStem: 迁移过程的高层计划会是什么样子？
options: Migrate in waves, assess, pilot, then build the landing zone
Assess, landing zone, pilot, migrate in waves, cut over, optimize
Cut over, decommission, assess, then optimize
Pilot, optimize, assess, then migrate everything in one weekend
questions.explain: Assess first and optimize last, because each phase depends on the one before it, and a pilot tests cutover and rollback before the main waves.
questions.zhExplain: 先评估、最后优化，因为每个阶段都依赖前一个阶段，而且试点会在主要迁移批次之前测试切换和回滚。

questions.stem: What are the main business and technical decision criteria that Levi Strauss & Co. should consider during the migration?
questions.zhStem: Levi Strauss & Co. 在迁移期间应考虑哪些主要的业务和技术决策标准？
options: Logo, store layout, and pricing; laptop and phone models
Headcount, office space, and travel; newest Azure features only
Cost, speed, and downtime; compatibility, security, and resilience
Product design and marketing; programming language only
questions.explain: Cost, speed, continuity, and strategic fit are the business criteria, and compatibility, security, performance, and resilience are the technical ones, because both decide whether each workload moves, how, and when.
questions.zhExplain: 成本、速度、业务连续性和战略契合度是业务标准，兼容性、安全性、性能和弹性是技术标准，因为两者共同决定每个工作负载是否迁移、如何迁移以及何时迁移。
